description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractGraphActor' that extends Akka's 'AbstractActor' and manages a stream graph for message processing. It provides infrastructure for message mapping, supervision strategy, counters for metrics, and stream source queue management, serving as a base class for stream-based actors.

classes.name: AbstractGraphActor
classes.description: An abstract class that manages an Akka stream graph for message processing, providing mechanisms for message mapping, supervision, and counters for metrics.

methods.name: mapMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to map incoming messages of type M to the stream message type T.

methods.name: beforeProcessMessage
methods.description: Hook to preprocess or modify messages before they are processed in the stream.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Abstract method to define the Sink for the stream processing.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the buffer size for the Source queue.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the Actor's message handling logic, setting up the source queue and message matchers.

methods.name: getSupervisionStrategyAttribute
methods.description: Creates supervision strategy attributes that log exceptions and resume processing.

methods.name: getSourceQueue
methods.description: Creates and returns the SourceQueue used to enqueue messages into the stream.

methods.name: incrementDequeueCounter
methods.description: Increments the dequeue counter each time an element is dequeued.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Method to add custom matchers before the default ones; does nothing by default.

methods.name: handleDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Handles DittoRuntimeExceptions by sending them back to sender.

methods.name: handleMatched
methods.description: Handles matched messages and enqueues them into the stream.

methods.name: incrementEnqueueCounters
methods.description: Updates counters based on the result of enqueue operations.

methods.name: handleUnknownThrowable
methods.description: Handles unexpected exceptions, logs them, and replies with an internal error.
